scenarios.name: Press Space after checking a staged command size option

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
ribbon customization is open in the MCAD Software for an empty Part Tools custom panel
the available command category is All Commands in ascending name order
the user selects 2-D Drawing and clicks the add button
2-D Drawing is staged and 2D Sketches is selected in the available list
the user clicks the staged 2-D Drawing Large checkbox
Large is checked and Text is unchecked for 2-D Drawing
3D Annotations is selected in the available list
the user cancels customization and reopens it for Part Tools
the custom panel list is empty
